parts:
Hello all,

I’m offering two half-day introductory workshops on training in data analysis over the next two weeks, and registration is now open!

Dec 15 - R, RStudio, and RMarkdown for exploring your data - https://dib-training.readthedocs.io/en/pub/2016-12-15-r-intro.html

Dec 20 - Jupyter Notebook for exploring your data - https://dib-training.readthedocs.io/en/pub/2016-12-20-jupyter-intro.html

Hope to see you there!

best,
—titus
